name: Network Planner
author: davidkarpik
description: A planning and analytics suite that reads the game's real demand grid and live line metrics. Planning shows where to grow: walk-catchment coverage, mode-shift potential (drivers whose home and work are both reachable), a ranked build-here-next list, and per-route and per-station riders vs drivers. Efficiency shows how well it runs: per-line load factor with plain-English advice, load-by-hour charts with day-over-day comparison and the game's service-frequency brackets, and the stops driving each line's crowding. Optional key-free satellite basemaps. The core analysis needs no setup.
